title: ASH Afterschool Learning Hub
description: A weekly afterschool program providing academic tutoring, mentorship, and performance-arts sessions to underserved students, helping them build literacy, numeracy, and confidence.

title: TACOTS Scholarship Initiative
description: A scholarship and holistic-support program covering tuition, learning materials, and mentorship for academically promising children from low-income families across Nigeria.

title: CEDAR Community Outreach Drive
description: Mobile community outreaches delivering medical, educational, and vocational support to rural and underserved communities in partnership with local volunteers.

title: Volunteer Capacity Building Bootcamp
description: An intensive training series equipping volunteers and facilitators with teaching, mentorship, and project-coordination skills to strengthen program delivery.

title: Digital Literacy for Secondary Schools
description: A computer and ICT skills program introducing secondary school students to digital tools, basic coding, and online safety to bridge the technology gap.

title: Creative Arts & Vocational Skills Camp
description: A holiday camp offering drama, music, dance, tailoring, and crafts, nurturing students' creative talents and practical skills alongside their academics.
